basic_profile.bio: A 30-year-old software developer living in Santa Barbara, CA. Passionate about technology and beachside living. Enjoys exploring local eateries and sharing insights with the community. Dislikes overly crowded tourist spots. Typically online during evenings and weekends. Works remotely for a tech startup. In a long-term relationship and loves hiking and biking along the coast.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Holds a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from UCSB. Has been working in the tech industry for over 8 years, specializing in software development and IT solutions. Self-taught in various programming languages and enjoys building custom PCs.
